edit.description: `emit_one`: carry a prior managed-projection placement only where the projection's current shape holds it

summary: Emit over a projection whose kind stopped rendering frontmatter carries the old `# temper: managed projection` note into the body as a stray first line; a second emit then rewrites it
acceptance: Overwriting a formerly-frontmatter projection with a frontmatterless render yields the same bytes as emitting onto an absent file, and the next emit reports it unchanged
tests: an emit over a projection whose kind dropped its frontmatter carries no stale managed-projection note
notes: Verified at 0351860e: write c99f5ef7's examples/base-harness/docs/systems/scanner.md over the tree, `temper emit` reports overwritten with the `# temper:` note above the banner; a second emit drops it (emitted). Cause: `placement_lines` of the prior file ride `placements` whatever `renders_frontmatter` now says. Schema modeline carry (install's) is out of scope unless the same cause.
